record.label: production-branch reference; deployment unverified
record.kind: on-being-hit confusion plus ability power on confusion (no PassiveEffects entry; logic in PokemonEntity.onHit and Status.triggerConfusion)
record.summary: Passive.PSYDUCK has NO PassiveEffects entry (routing uncertainty NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY); it is read in two places: PokemonEntity.onHit and Status.triggerConfusion. PSYDUCK (1 star) and GOLDUCK (2 stars) are WATER + PSYCHIC, maxPP 100, range 1, skill PSYSHOCK. (1) When an enemy's basic attack on the holder counts as successful (not dodged and not blocked by protect or skydiving; damage may still be 0), the attacker's onHit gives a chance(0.1, attacker) roll; on success the holder is confused for a requested 3000 ms (origin = holder itself, apBoost false so no AP scaling). The probability is 0.1^(1 - attackerLuck/100), capped at 1, and uses the ATTACKER's luck, not the holder's. (2) Whenever the holder becomes confused through Status.triggerConfusion from any source (this passive, Confusion/other abilities, status transfer), it gains addAbilityPower(100, self, apBoost 0, crit false), not permanent. Guards: triggerConfusion does nothing if the holder is already confused, has runeProtect (the Rune Protect status flag) or IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; no AP is gained in those cases. Applied duration = requested 3000 ms after the duration reductions (Swift Swim 0.7, else Hydration 0.5, else Water Veil / Surge Surfer 0.3, then Odd Keystone 10% per stone); Persim Berry held is eaten right after confusion is set (it clears the confusion but the +100 AP is still given afterwards, because the AP step comes after the berry in the code). Applied AP change: requested 100, Big Eater Belt makes it 125 (x1.25 rounded down; positive self-buff), Twist Band does nothing for a positive value, Nullify Bandanna turns it into +20 attack (round(0.2 x 100)) and no AP; ap is clamped at -100 minimum. While confused the holder targets via getTargetWhenConfused: with chance(0.5, holder) it only picks enemies, otherwise allies and itself are possible targets. No gameplay claims; source reading plus mechanical checks only.
triggers: PokemonEntity.onHit on the ATTACKER: target.passive === Passive.PSYDUCK && chance(0.1, this) -> target.status.triggerConfusion(3000, target, target); onHit is called from PokemonState.attack only when isAttackSuccessful
Status.triggerConfusion on the holder (any source): pkm.passive === Passive.PSYDUCK -> pkm.addAbilityPower(100, pkm, 0, false)

effects.scaling: no AP scaling (apBoost false, origin is the holder); probability uses the attacker's luck: min(1, 0.1^(1 - luck/100))
effects.resolution: requested: confusion for 3000 ms on the holder. Applied: only if the attack was successful (not dodged, no protect/skydiving), the holder is not already confused, has no runeProtect and no IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; duration then goes through applyStatusDurationReductions (Swift Swim x0.7, else Hydration x0.5, else Water Veil / Surge Surfer x0.3; Odd Keystone x(1-0.1n)) and Math.round; the sandstorm x1.3 branch is not applied because apBoost is false. A held Persim Berry is eaten at once.

effects.declaredRaw: +100 AP each time confusion is applied to the holder
effects.scaling: addAbilityPower(100, self, 0, false): no AP or crit scaling; not permanent (entity only, board pokemon unchanged)
effects.resolution: requested: +100 AP. Applied: Big Eater Belt x1.25 rounded down -> 125 (positive self-buff), Twist Band no effect on positive values, Nullify Bandanna replaces it with +round(0.2 x 100) = +20 attack and no AP; ap is clamped to >= -100. Given only when triggerConfusion actually applies confusion (not already confused, no runeProtect, no IMMUNITY_CONFUSION); the AP is not removed when confusion ends, and there is no stack limit other than needing a new confusion after the previous one ended.

effects.declaredRaw: consequence of the confusion status, not of the passive
effects.resolution: while confused the holder retargets through getTargetWhenConfused: chance(0.5, holder) -> only enemies at the nearest distance; otherwise allies and the holder itself are also candidates. Confusion ends when confusionCooldown (decreased each status update) reaches 0.

conditions: The passive is recognised by entity.passive === Passive.PSYDUCK (both lines are on the Psyduck/Golduck classes only).

Hit trigger needs a successful basic attack: dodge or protect/skydiving makes isAttackSuccessful false and onHit is not called; abilities and other damage sources do not call onHit (only caller found in PokemonState.attack).
The AP bonus is tied to any confusion application on the holder, not only to this passive's own roll.
If the holder is already confused the new application is ignored: no duration refresh and no extra AP.
record.resetBehaviour: Entity status is built per fight; confusion lasts its (reduced) duration and ends on cooldown, Persim Berry or other cleanse code; gained AP stays for the rest of the fight (no removal found in the code read). Nothing persists to the board pokemon.
dependsOnUnverifiedGenericCombat: Other callers that clear confusion (e.g. cleanse abilities or item effects) were not enumerated beyond Persim Berry and the status update
Other places that read Passive.PSYDUCK: grep of app/core and app/models found only pokemon-entity.ts:990 and status.ts:831 plus the unit classes
unresolved: NO_PASSIVE_EFFECTS_ENTRY: PSYDUCK has no PassiveEffects entry; behaviour is inline in onHit and triggerConfusion (read directly, both cited).
Reading of the AP step: addAbilityPower is called after eatBerry(PERSIM_BERRY) in the same block, so the AP is granted even when Persim clears the confusion at once; not tested.
Whether the Golduck 2-star and Psyduck 1-star differ in any behaviour: no star-dependent code was found; only base stats differ (not recorded here).
Whether confusion from transferNegativeStatus is reachable for these units in play was not traced.
No gameplay evidence; candidate is source reading plus mechanical checks.

evidence.note: PSYDUCK: 1 star, WATER + PSYCHIC, maxPP 100, range 1, skill PSYSHOCK
GOLDUCK: 2 stars, WATER + PSYCHIC, maxPP 100, range 1, skill PSYSHOCK

in the attacker's onHit, a target whose passive is PSYDUCK is confused for 3000 ms with probability chance(0.1, this); this is the ATTACKER (luck of the attacker), origin and pkm are both the Psyduck-line target, apBoost defaults to false
onHit is called on the attacker only when isAttackSuccessful; it is the only caller found (grep for onHit( in app/core)
isAttackSuccessful turns false on a dodge (unless XRAY_VISION, LOCK_ON or target paralysed/asleep/frozen/locked) and when the target has status.protect or skydiving
chance(p, pokemon) = Math.random() < min(cap=1, p^(1 - luck/100)); 0 returns false

confusion is applied only if not already confused, no runeProtect and no IMMUNITY_CONFUSION; sandstorm x1.3 only when apBoost; then duration reductions; Persim Berry eaten; if pkm.passive is PSYDUCK the confused unit gains addAbilityPower(100) with apBoost 0, crit false, not permanent
SWIFT_SWIM x0.7, else HYDRATION x0.5, else WATER_VEIL or SURGE_SURFER x0.3; then Odd Keystone x(1 - 0.1 per stone)

NULLIFY_BANDANNA converts AP into round(0.2 x value) attack instead; otherwise value is scaled (apBoost 0, crit false -> unchanged), passes the Big Eater Belt and Twist Band helpers, then ap = max(-100, ap + value); the permanent flag is false so only the entity changes
Big Eater Belt multiplies a positive change by 1.25 (rounded down to 0 digits); Twist Band only acts on negative values
confusion ends when the cooldown reaches 0; the target is then cleared
confusion cooldown is decreased each update while confused
a confused unit picks its attack target through getTargetWhenConfused
with probability chance(0.5) the confusion is bypassed (enemies only); otherwise allies are also candidates and the unit itself is added to the candidates (it may attack itself)
Persim Berry clears confusion and its cooldown, adds IMMUNITY_CONFUSION and heals 50
transferNegativeStatus re-applies an existing confusion through triggerConfusion on the receiving entity (so a receiving PSYDUCK-line unit would gain the AP)
